=== lv-pent-251
lvFlat = \markup { \raise #0.6 \small \flat }
lvSharp = \markup { \raise #0.6 \small \sharp }
lvEx = {
  <c e g b>1-\markup { "maj7" } <c e g b d'>1-\markup { "maj9" } <c e g a>1-\markup { "6" }
  <c ees g bes>1-\markup { "m7" } <c ees g bes d'>1-\markup { "m9" } <c e g bes>1-\markup { "7" }
  <c ees ges bes>1-\markup { "ø" } <c ees ges beses>1-\markup { "°7" } <c ees g b>1-\markup { "m(maj7)" }
  <c ees g a>1-\markup { "m6" } <c f g bes>1-\markup { "sus" } <c f g bes d'>1-\markup { "9sus" }
  <c e g bes des'>1-\markup { "7" \lvFlat "9" } <c e g bes dis'>1-\markup { "7" \lvSharp "9" }
  <c e gis bes dis'>1-\markup { "7alt" } <c e g bes d' fis'>1-\markup { "7" \lvSharp "11" }
  <c e g b fis'>1-\markup { "maj7" \lvSharp "11" } <c e gis b>1-\markup { "maj7" \lvSharp "5" }
  <c f g bes des'>1-\markup { "sus" \lvFlat "9" } <c e g bes d' a'>1-\markup { "13" } <c e g a d'>1-\markup { "6/9" }
}
\layout { \context { \ChordNames chordNameExceptions = #(append (sequential-music-to-chord-exceptions lvEx #t) ignatzekExceptions) } }
\score { <<
  \new ChordNames \chordmode { d1:m7 g:7 c:maj7 c:maj7 }
  \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \time 4/4 \override Score.NonMusicalPaperColumn.line-break-permission = ##f r8 g'8 a'8 b'8 d''8 e''8 d''8 b'8 | a'8 g'8 e'8 g'8 a'4 b'8 d''8~ | d''4 b'8 a'8 g'8 e'8 g'4 | b'2. r4 \bar "|." }
>> \layout { } }

  \new PianoStaff <<
    \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \time 4/4 \override Score.NonMusicalPaperColumn.line-break-permission = ##f <b e'>2 <d' f'>2 | <d' g'>2 <e' a'>2 | <c' b'>2 <a' c''>2 | <bes' d''~>2 <g' a' d''>2 \bar "|." }
    \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \clef bass \time 4/4 <c g>2 <b, a>2 | <bes, aes>2 <a, g>2 | <aes, ges>2 <g, f>2 | <ges, f>2 <f, c>2 \bar "|." }
  >>
>> \layout { } }

  >>
>> \layout { } }

  \new PianoStaff <<
    \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \time 4/4 \override Score.NonMusicalPaperColumn.line-break-permission = ##f \mark \markup \small "Dạo đầu" <c' e' g'>2 <c' fis' a'>2 | <bes d' f'>2 <bes e' g'>2 | <c' e' g'>2 <c' fis' a'>2 | <bes d' f'>2 <bes e' g'>2 \break \mark \markup \small "Kết (tag ba lần)" <c' e' g'>2 <c' fis' a'>2 | <bes d' f'>2 <bes e' g'>2 | <c' e' g'>2 <c' fis' a'>2 | <bes d' f'>2 <bes e' g'>2 \break <c' e' g'>2 <c' fis' a'>2 | <bes d' f'>2 <bes e' g'>2 | <c' e' a'>1 \bar "|." }
    \new Staff { \accidentalStyle modern \clef bass \time 4/4 c1 | c1 | c1 | c1 | a,2 d2 | g,2 c2 | a,2 d2 | g,2 c2 | a,2 d2 | g,2 c2 | f,1 \bar "|." }
  >>
>> \layout { } }
